name: Verog's Head
summary: Regthar Deathgate seeks Verog's Head as proof of the Kolkar leader's death. The chieftain commands forces around the Stagnant Oasis, and his defeat is meant to weaken the tribes threatening the Barrens.

sections.title: A Trophy of the Oasis
sections.body: The Kolkar centaur threaten Horde travelers and supply routes across the northern Barrens. Verog the Dervish roams the arid scrubland, leaving his command tent at the Stagnant Oasis vulnerable. Horde operatives attack his forces around the pavilion until an alarm sounds. Verog rushes back to defend his camp, where he is slain and decapitated. Regthar Deathgate receives his head as proof that another dangerous Kolkar chieftain has fallen. Barak Kodobane's head is already on display beside it.

faq.answer: Verog the Dervish was a Kolkar centaur warlord based at the Stagnant Oasis in the Barrens. He roamed the arid plains and commanded the hostile forces around the oasis tent.
Regthar Deathgate, an orc veteran at an encampment west of the Crossroads, wants Verog's head. He collects trophies from slain Kolkar warlords to weaken their warbands and morale.
Verog's encampment and command tent are at the Stagnant Oasis, southeast of the Crossroads. He returns to defend his post when centaur guards are slain and an alarm is raised.

faq.q: What happens to the head after it is turned in?
aliases: what does regthar do with the head
faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate places Verog's head beside Barak Kodobane's. The heads mark the Horde's campaign against Kolkar leaders.

angles.text: Defeating Verog and taking his head helps secure Horde routes between the Crossroads and the southern Barrens against centaur raids.
As a tauren, you know the weight of the Kolkar defeat: your people have endured generations of brutal warfare against the centaur tribes of Kalimdor.
